# awscc_servicediscovery_service (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description for the service.
- `dns_config` (Attributes) DNS-related configurations for the service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_config))
- `health_check_config` (Attributes) Settings for health checks. Used when routing is DNS-based. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check_config))
- `health_check_custom_config` (Attributes) Settings for custom health checks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check_custom_config))
- `name` (String) The name of the service.
- `namespace_id` (String) The ID of the namespace in which the service is created.
- `service_attributes` (Map of String) A string map that contains attributes and values for the service. You can specify a maximum of 30 key-value pairs.
- `tags` (Attributes List) An array of key-value pairs to associate with the service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `type` (String) The type of service. Supported values are HTTP or DNS.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the service.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `service_id` (String) The unique identifier for the service.

<a id="nestedatt--dns_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_config`

Optional:

- `dns_records` (Attributes List) A list of DNS records associated with the service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_config--dns_records))
- `namespace_id` (String) The ID of the namespace for the DNS configuration.
- `routing_policy` (String) The routing policy to use for DNS queries.

<a id="nestedatt--dns_config--dns_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_config.dns_records`

Optional:

- `ttl` (Number) The time-to-live (TTL) for the DNS record.
- `type` (String) The DNS record type (e.g., A, AAAA, SRV).



<a id="nestedatt--health_check_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check_config`

Optional:

- `failure_threshold` (Number) The number of consecutive health check failures that must occur before declaring the service unhealthy.
- `resource_path` (String) The path to ping on the service for health checks.
- `type` (String) The type of health check (e.g., HTTP, HTTPS, TCP).


<a id="nestedatt--health_check_custom_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check_custom_config`

Optional:

- `failure_threshold` (Number) The number of consecutive health check failures required before the service is considered unhealthy.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_servicediscovery_service.example
  identity = {
    id = "id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the service

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_servicediscovery_service.example
  id = "id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_servicediscovery_service.example "id"
```
